_comment: IMPORTANT — max_tokens must leave room for the prompt. Groq charges prompt + max_tokens against its per-minute token budget, so a max_tokens at or above the TPM limit makes EVERY request fail with HTTP 413 ('Request too large ... tokens per minute (TPM): Limit 8000, Requested 8268') before the model is even reached. That is exactly what happened here: three models shipped with max_tokens 8192 against an 8000 TPM limit and could never answer. Values below leave roughly half the budget for the prompt.
_tpm_limits_measured_2026_07_31: Read from x-ratelimit-limit-tokens on the on_demand tier: qwen/qwen3.6-27b 8000, openai/gpt-oss-120b 8000, openai/gpt-oss-20b 8000, llama-3.3-70b-versatile 12000, llama-3.1-8b-instant 6000, groq/compound 70000, groq/compound-mini 70000. These are per-account: re-check yours with `curl -D - -X POST https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROVIDER_GROQ_API_KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"MODEL","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":1}'` and raise max_tokens if you are on a paid tier.
